title: Lope de Soria (Genoa) to Charles V and Gattinara, 1523, RAH Salazar A-28 (9/28), DECODE R9488-R9498

steps.what: Fetched all 35 images of R9488-R9498 and the metadata via the DECODE API.
CSP Spain vol. 2 (BHO): only f. 577 calendared, from the clear parts.
Searched DECODE for decrypted Soria records; found R9844 (9/30) with cipher and court decipherment in key B.
Checked the BRAH 9/15 key book (R9815-R9832) for either key; no alphabet matches.
Checked a decrypted 9/28 sibling of another envoy (Alonso Sanchez, R9768) for a shared key; different cipher.
Aligned the first R9844 cipher lines with the clear: code groups sub, yed, xab, xin, xud, si, tef, zeb and a dozen letter values.
Read R9497 (13 Aug 1523) key-B cipher lines 1-7 with the R9844 key: Andrea Doria and the Prince of Salerno discontented with the King of France; approach via Jeronimo Doria.
Subagent read R9494 (26 Jul 1523) key-B blocks: courier, 28,000 escudos for Swiss in Constance, 12,000 to the treasurer; collated with R9495.
Subagent first pass on R9491 (20 Jul, to Gattinara) key-B block: Siena under the Emperor's hand; much of the key-B letter alphabet in this letter still unassigned.
Transcribed R9492 f. 444r-445v key-A block (~1060 signs, 31 lines) with an ASCII glyph scheme.
Sign counts showed ~25 signs, word division kept, lone 'f' 10x (=y), c followed by T 43x (a c+T ligature).

Simulated-annealing substitution solver with a 4-gram model of Danvila's 1520-21 Castilian documents; 'f'=y fixed; found the key-A alphabet (liga general, cinco mil infantes, exercito) from random starts; c+T merged as d.
Hand refinement: alpha=o, q=o (lone q = que), 9/p=a, z=e, e/n=s, c=n, 2=l, code leh=en.
June letter transcribed and collated across its three copies (R9488 full, R9489 full, R9490 spot); copy-to-copy variants confirmed the key-A homophones and fixed code words cip, mos, lim.
June letter read end to end with key A; cap=que, lod=de, luc=duque, lih=Milan from context.
R9492 key-A block re-read at high zoom and collated with the duplicate R9493; d=m, long-stem hook=f corrected; reads continuously.
Key-B passages of R9491 (Siena), R9492 f.448, R9494 and R9497 read in substance; Beaurain identified.

Lasry review (email 25 Sept 2026): key B used plaintext from outside the target (R9844 decipherment), so the target is not 100% ciphertext-only. Method changed from 'key recovered from ciphertext-only' to 'key recovered based on plaintext from external sources'; key A remains a ciphertext-only break.

Lasry (25 Sept 2026): classify by the primary achievement and split mixed cases. Entry split: key A letters = key recovered from ciphertext-only (primary), key B letters = key from external plaintext; one Results row each.

Collated R9497 block 1 sign by sign with the duplicate R9498 from the images to close the gaps in the quotation for Lasry's list. R9498 spells in code (pep un, tun parte, xap le) what R9497 spells in letters, which corrected 'prometido' to 'quitado' (p-hook with o = q), 'pariente' to 'uno', '[qua]tro' to 'quatro' (tall L = q) and 'sob 7.' to 'quiere' (sob = quier, cf. R9491 'qualquiera cosa'); 'xuf yic' = [hablado] from the code's alphabetical blocks (I). Block 1 now reads continuously (read_r9497_full.md).

Checked whether the existing fraction_read (0.85) counted sense: it did not. It was an estimate taken from NOTES prose; the readings were line tables mixing clear text and glosses, not token-aligned, so nothing had been counted.

Wrote measure/measure.py: the unit is one cipher sign or one code group. Key-A letters are aligned line by line (difflib) between the mechanical key-A decrypt of keyA_june.txt / keyA_r9492_v2.txt (measure/deca.py) and hand readings (measure/r_june.txt, r_july.txt); key-B letters are hand-aligned word by word with their units (measure/kb_*.txt). A unit counts as read only if every word it carries is unbracketed and passes a sense test: in a Castilian lexicon (Quijote, Vasto memorias, Danvila 1520-21; c/z, u/b, f/h variants and enclitics allowed), a proper name, or a 6+ letter word the es-golden-age LM scores >= -1.9/char (gibberish of the same letters scores -4 to -7). Context-only code values are bracketed and count unread. Per-letter LM of the read text is -1.3 to -1.8/char against shuffled controls of -5.8 to -6.0.

Re-read the key-A open stretches of the July letter on R9492 f.444r/445v and the duplicate R9493 f.450v: 7ozeP = Bresa (7 = b, P = a), 3P29e = valas (P = a), OanP2zTze = coseletes, Op29Oqc = calaran. 'an fec que la' (L10) and 'Q?o Lo79' (L11-12) stay unread: the two copies differ there (R9493 'pc qzoqz 2z3po').

R9493 f.455r (duplicate of R9492) carries the closing in KEY A, struck through, with the clerk's interlinear decipherment 'es arrivado aqui monsr de beaurre y pues por el sera informado V. Md de todo lo mas ocurre', and the whole Post data in key A. As a second witness to R9492's key-B text it gives zub = aqui, pef = todo, to = mas, pub = vaya, and facilmente, podrian, topar, toma(r)lo. mul (key A) = porque ('porque estando las galeras de Francia'), which also reads July L24 'la guerra porque desto se seguirian'.

R9492 f.448r Post data (8 lines, unread before) re-read from img P5: queriendo se embarcar el dicho Beurren con este vergantin, yo le desconsejado que no vaya si no en una buena carraca, porque estando las galeras de Francia y otros vergantines por esta marina facilmente podrian topar con el y tomarlo, lo que no faran con la carraca; y por esto avemos pensado que se parta este vergantin con Lorenzo Mormino, y el se partira de aqui a tres dias con una carraca. pel = ver- (vergantin, twice), 4 = m (Mormino).

The clear text at the foot of R9491 f.441r ('se a detenido este vergantin y Lorenzo Mormino esperando los despachos de Milan') fixed 'xip c7yhr 2Fc4Qyr' = Lorenço Mormino and yif = este (it had been read 'dos').

R9494 re-read (f.478v-479r) and collated with R9495 and, for the first time, R9496 (f.483r). Values: pes = yo ('el e yo avemos escrito'; also R9497 'yo e apretado'), pef = todo, znb/za = aca, z-tail = x (dexado, R9495), V = g (Geneva; R9495 writes 9#). R9496 opens with a paragraph not in R9494/R9495: Beurren [partira] [..] con una carraca y yra derecho a Barcelona con el [..] Martin Centurion por embaxador de este duque y comunidad de Genova; yac = duque, xic = Genova, yud = embaxad-.

R9491 f.441r re-read at 1.25x: pel = ver- gives 'rezia cosa es aver de hazerse qualquiera cosa por voto de muchos'; to = mas ('seria mas facil de hazerse'); sab = puede in both R9491 ('lo que no se puede a una republica') and R9497 ('no se puede parlar nada'); yac = duque ('el duque de [pu-ii] quiere que se govierne por la republica'); 'im-porta a su Magestad el buen govierno de aquella ciudad'. 'libertad' no longer counted: its first group sob is 'quier' everywhere else. 'varias' (pug) kept unread. Still open: pu-ii (Sesa?), taf lb, a six-sign word in l.3, tu, pud (3x, no single value fits), zib, sib (2x), nine signs of l.7, tad, tac, toya, xif.

R9497 block 2 and f.579r: xag = hable, confirmed by the clear sequel 'pues el dicho Martin Centurion abra hablado sobre ello'; xa = hasta, xob = hecha, tin = papa, inside their alphabetical blocks; paf [tiempo], sud [respuesta], xuf yic [hablado] and z7a [hara] kept unread because other words fit. 'gto'/'g+o' after Salerno is a closer (R9498 'g+o' then closer signs).

Measured (measure/measure.py): June (key A) 809/813 = 99.5%; July body (key A) 1127/1150 = 98.0%; July post data (key B) 271/274 = 98.9%; 20 July to Gattinara 476/529 = 90.0%; 26 July (R9494-96) 328/357 = 91.9%; 13 Aug 401/410 = 97.8%; overall 3,412/3,533 units = 96.6%. 210 key-A units read through homophone/polyphone variants the mechanical table does not hold (P = a/g, 7 = i/b, cT = d/nt) count read because the word is forced.

outcome.method_basis: Split entry (Lasry, 25 Sept 2026: classify by the primary achievement, split mixed cases). Primary: key A, which carries the June letter and the body of the July letter (R9488-R9490, R9492-R9493), was broken from the ciphertext alone by simulated annealing with a Castilian 4-gram model plus hand fixes, with no key or crib. Second part: key B (from late July: R9491, the R9492 post data, R9494-R9498) was rebuilt from an external plaintext, the court's decipherment of Soria's 30 Dec 1523 letter R9844 (Salazar 9/30).
outcome.notes: Read under the 95% rule (5 Oct 2026, measured 96.6%). The two short key-B letters of 20 and 26 July stay at 90-92%: their open groups are single-occurrence key-B codes (taf, tu, zib, sib, tac, xif, tad, te, per, tep, zu, tol ...) with no attestation in the R9844 crib, the duplicates or print. Key-A codes rip (4x), pur (3x), qed (2x), dus (2x), cop (1x) unread: context suggests Venetians, V. Magestad, Swiss, but there is no second source.
